decision: Accept extra O-lens phrases and resume the originally planned stochastic samples. Preserve original format_valid flags as literal compliance metadata, not exclusion criteria. Retain all phrases and raw tokens.
authorization: User: Are the O-lens outputs sensible? If so, it is fine that there are extra phrases.
assessment: Topic-sensitive but noisy exploratory readouts; not a validated factual or perspective classifier.
evidence: Tylenol fact anchor switches from overdose-related at 8000mg to ordinary-dose language at 1000mg.
Test-status fact and appraisal anchors distinguish failed from passing tests.
Crossed frustration appraisal changes from frustration/apology to gratitude.
limitations: Correct arithmetic and fraction controls also attract incorrect-answer language.
Permission control still attracts privacy objections at request boundary.
Readouts invent numerical and contextual details; individual phrases are not literal thoughts or reliable facts.
review_scope: Manual qualitative review of selected fact anchors and beginning/end phrases of appraisal and request readouts across all ten families; not an exhaustive or blinded phrase-level annotation.
